title: Colossians
author: Paul the apostle.
historicalSetting: Colossians exalts the supremacy and sufficiency of Christ against false teaching.
keyVerse: Colossians 1:18 — "That in all things he might have the preeminence."
christFocus: Colossians is deeply Christ-centered, proclaiming Jesus as image of the invisible God, Creator, reconciler, head of the church, and fullness of God.
